lessons.title: 1. Filter Rows
lessons.description: Implement `filter_rows(rows, key, value)` keeping dict rows where row[key]==value.
lessons.solution_code:
def filter_rows(rows, key, value):
    return [r for r in rows if r.get(key) == value]

lessons.title: 2. Select Columns
lessons.description: Implement `select(rows, cols)` returning new dicts with only cols.
lessons.solution_code:
def select(rows, cols):
    return [{c: r[c] for c in cols if c in r} for r in rows]

4. Inner Join (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `inner_join(left, right, key)` joining lists of dicts on key.

tests.name: test_inner_join
tests.unittest_code:
def test_inner_join(self):
    left = [{'id': 1, 'n': 'a'}, {'id': 2, 'n': 'b'}]
    right = [{'id': 1, 's': 10}, {'id': 3, 's': 30}]
    res = inner_join(left, right, 'id')
    self.assertEqual(len(res), 1)
    self.assertEqual(res[0]['n'], 'a')
    self.assertEqual(res[0]['s'], 10)
